summary: Iteration 2 testing covered new Progress Snapshots feature (backend + admin restore UI + Markham login badge). 39/39 pytest tests pass (24 regression + 15 new snapshot tests). Frontend snapshot CRUD flows (open modal, create manual, restore with pre_restore creation, delete) all verified end-to-end via Playwright. No critical issues found; one minor frontend testid naming note for E1.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 806 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/progress.py, routers/admin_snapshots.py, services/snapshots.py for future maintainability.
_create_snapshot prune query uses skip+sort which is O(N) — fine at 10 retention but document the assumption.
Login snapshot is wrapped in try/except that silently logs warnings; consider exposing as a debug field in /api/auth/me for QA visibility (not a bug).
seed_data_creation: Tests create+cleanup their own ephemeral students (test_snap_*, test_restore_*, test_ret_*, test_cas_*); demo student left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stat-card testids use prefix 'admin-stat-*' (not 'stat-*'). The 5th card 'Cloud snapshots' uses data-testid='admin-stat-snapshots'. Snapshots modal opens via data-testid='snapshots-<userId>' button per row. Inside modal: input is plain <input>, button is data-testid='create-snapshot-btn', per row data-testid='restore-snapshot-<snapId>' and 'delete-snapshot-<snapId>'. Restore uses window.confirm() — accept dialog in Playwright. Login badge text is exactly 'MTO BDE · Markham, Ontario' on right hero of /login.
